methodology: Stage B projection that combines measured SHAKE permutation counts with a 255-column-compliant Keccak candidate and a row model for the arithmetic slice. Proof bytes come from a synthetic Winterfell proxy AIR at the same width/length and proof options.

fields.name: f64
fields.note: Goldilocks prime field; Winterfell docs note that a quadratic extension is needed for ~100-bit proof soundness.

fields.name: f128
fields.note: Pinned Yano-derived local prover/verifier field choice.

keccak_air_candidate.methodology: 35-column bit-plane candidate. Each row carries one Keccak bit-plane over the 25 state bits; theta uses 5 extra C bits and 5 extra D bits. Current and next rows carry phase input/output so step outputs are not double-counted as extra trace columns. One round is serialized into theta, rho/pi, and chi+iota passes of 64 rows each.

arithmetic_slice_model.methodology: Row model for the arithmetic slice of ML-DSA-44 Verify_internal using one row per butterfly or coefficient-local arithmetic relation. This is a Stage B trace-shape model, not yet a proved AIR.

components.label: pk_decode_t1_materialize
components.rationale: One row per decoded t1 coefficient.

components.label: sig_decode_z_materialize
components.rationale: One row per decoded z coefficient.

components.label: sig_decode_hint_materialize
components.rationale: One row per materialized hint coefficient after HintBitUnpack.

components.label: scale_t1_by_2_pow_d
components.rationale: One row per t1 coefficient to multiply by 2^d before NTT.

components.label: forward_ntt
components.rationale: Butterfly count for NTT(z), NTT(c), and NTT(t1 * 2^d).

components.label: ahat_times_ntt_z
components.rationale: One row per pointwise multiply in Ahat o NTT(z).

components.label: ntt_c_times_ntt_t1
components.rationale: One row per pointwise multiply in NTT(c) o NTT(t1 * 2^d).

components.label: pointwise_accumulate_and_subtract
components.rationale: Four binary add/sub rows per output coefficient to sum four products and subtract the correction term.

components.label: inverse_ntt
components.rationale: Butterfly count for inverse NTT over k output polynomials.

components.label: use_hint
components.rationale: One row per coefficient for Decompose/UseHint reconstruction.

components.label: w1_encode
components.rationale: One row per coefficient to pack w1' for ctilde' hashing.

components.label: z_norm
components.rationale: One row per z coefficient for the infinity-norm bound check.

proof_proxy.note: Synthetic affine-copy AIR with the same trace width/length and Yano-mirrored Winterfell proof options except for using the available 256-bit SHA3 hasher in crates.io Winterfell. This is a proof-size proxy, not a proof of ML-DSA verification.
